articles.title: At Sea-Air-Space 2026 HII Celebrates Manufacturing Job Creation, Expansion of U.S. Shipbuilding Industrial Base
articles.summary: HII and shipbuilding partners from six states participated in the U.S. Navy League's Sea-Air-Space Exposition 2026 in National Harbor, Md. This event served to underscore crucial messages about robust shipbuilding and advanced naval capabilities. Such industry-state collaborations are vital for national defense and maintaining strategic maritime dominance, highlighting collective efforts in bolstering naval strength.
